create_llff_dataset: create an LLFFDataset instance to load LLFF scene images and compute rays for NeRF training
compute_average_poses: compute the average camera pose from a set of poses using average_poses function
center_poses_for_ndc: center camera poses around the average pose using center_poses for NDC space conversion
generate_spiral_render_path: generate a spiral rendering path with get_spiral for novel view synthesis from camera poses
build_view_matrix: build a camera view matrix from z axis, up vector, and position using viewmatrix function
